baci.name: BACI (CEPII)
baci.coverage: 1995-2022, ~200 countries, HS6 exporter x importer x year, reconciled value + quantity
baci.granularity: HS6 bilateral flows; value in 1000 USD, quantity in tonnes
baci.window_coverage: full 2012-2022 (11 yearly CSVs extracted to data/baci/)
baci.role: primary bilateral trade edges + trade-flow labels
baci.citation: CEPII BACI: International Trade Database at the Product-Level, HS92 revision V202601

gravity.name: CEPII Gravity
gravity.granularity: country-pair x year: distance, contiguity, common language, colonial ties, RTA, GDP
gravity.citation: Conte, Cotterlaz, Mayer (2022) 'The CEPII Gravity database', CEPII Working Paper 2022-05

eurostat_comext.name: Eurostat Comext
eurostat_comext.coverage: EU27 reporting, 2002-2025, monthly/annual; SITC Rev.4 aggregates (TOTAL + 7 SITC sections)
eurostat_comext.granularity: SITC Rev.4 section level (NOT CN8); intra-EU and extra-EU partner splits
eurostat_comext.gaps: CN8 granularity requires bulk Comext download (registration); API serves SITC aggregates only
eurostat_comext.citation: Eurostat, International trade in goods - Comext

un_comtrade.name: UN Comtrade
un_comtrade.window_coverage: not downloaded; BACI covers window at HS6, Comtrade kept as monthly-frequency fallback
un_comtrade.gaps: rate-limited preview API; bulk requires payment

imf_dots.name: IMF DOTS
imf_dots.access: free via data.imf.org, but no public unauthenticated API found (2026-08-10); datamapper API exposes macro indicators only, not bilateral DOTS
imf_dots.gaps: no public API endpoint for bilateral DOTS series

census_intl_trade.name: Census International Trade API
census_intl_trade.access: free API, requires API key (api.census.gov returns 'Missing Key' without one)
census_intl_trade.coverage: US, 2010- monthly; state x NAICS x destination country
census_intl_trade.window_coverage: not downloaded; blocked on API key

usitc_dataweb.name: USITC DataWeb
usitc_dataweb.coverage: US, 1989-; HTS10, duty rates, districts, ports

scripts.download_cepii.py: downloads BACI HS92 zip + Gravity CSV zip to cache/; writes cache/manifest.json; --force to re-download
scripts.download_eurostat.py: downloads Comext intra/extra-EU JSON to cache/; --force to re-download
scripts.normalize_baci.py: extracts BACI_HS92_Y{2012..2022}_V202601.csv from zip to data/baci/baci_hs92_YYYY.csv
scripts.normalize_gravity.py: subsets Gravity_V202211.csv to 2012-2022 -> data/gravity_window.csv; copies Countries table
scripts.normalize_eurostat.py: flattens Comext JSON (SDMX long format) to data/comext_*.csv
